title: Kyiv startup develops pocket receiver for drone feeds
excerpt: A new 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops view video feeds from Russian drones, though future tech shifts could limit its effectiveness.
body_html:
A startup in Kyiv has created a portable receiver that allows Ukrainian soldiers to intercept and watch video feeds from Russian drones.

The compact device weighs 10 ounces and fits in a pocket. By capturing these video transmissions, troops can monitor drone activity in real time.

However, future technological developments could limit the usefulness of this tool. Russian forces are moving toward digital video systems and AI-guided drones that do not emit detectable signals.
